title: 第19章 审判异端第20章 意外的修罗场
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
听着狄曼列的话，从小到大没被人这么对待过的贵族青年终于再也忍不住怒火：“你知道我是谁吗？！我舅舅可是休莫公爵！！！”
话音落下，无论是狱警还是犯人都露出了惊讶的表情
莫森帝国八位公爵之一，光是他的名字就足以让一座城市抖一抖了，更别提眼前这个自称是他外甥的贵族
就连身为元素精灵龙的维罗娜都知道很不妙，这件事变的很复杂，在心里默默祈祷着自己救命恩人的紫发青年可以不牵扯进去，哪怕放弃审判卡里伯爵这个凶手
当然，她也做好了挣脱束缚魔具，变回巨龙形态逃跑来吸引注意力的准备
然而面对贵族青年这足以让大多数人恭敬以对的话，狄曼列仍然一副平静的样子，甚至没有回应
狄曼列看着卡里伯爵，缓缓在档案册上记录了一笔：
“针对以上罪行，执行判决——————”
“冰寒之刑，死刑”
话音落下，没等任何人反应过来，两道魔法阵已经瞬间笼罩了卡里伯爵，而后猛然亮起
直到逐渐变成冰雕的卡里伯爵发出惨叫和求饶，狱警和犯人，以及在场所有人才意识到发生了什么
“狄曼列典狱长，我，我交代所有事还有全部的钱啊啊啊啊啊！！！！求你放过啊啊啊啊给我个痛快啊啊啊啊！！！”
显然，卡里伯爵刚刚一直都将最后的希望放在那个贵族青年身上，现在死亡的恐惧降临后才认清现实
不过对于狄曼列来说，求饶与否，并没有区别
面对这残忍一幕，才诞生十几年的维罗娜下意识的捂住了眼睛，但又强迫自己睁开
她并非不忍或同情，只是几乎没有直面过这么残酷的事，毕竟她以前只和一些温和的精灵接触
但身为元素精灵龙，她还是迅速接受着这一切的信息，化为自己心智成长的养料
只是不等她逐渐接受，狄曼列已经举起了手杖，朝着还未死亡的卡里伯爵敲了下去
咔啦——————
随着破碎声音响起，卡里伯爵的手臂直接被敲成了冰渣，最终散落一地

他的血液以及骨骼都被彻底冻结，因此没有一滴血液流出
“啊啊啊啊啊.......”
寒冰已经蔓延到了卡里伯爵的咽喉，导致他只能发出痛苦的呜咽声
见到这一幕，维罗娜终于忍不住闭上了眼睛，手下意识的抓住了狄曼列的黑色风衣
一旁的贵族青年也是被震撼的一句话说不出来，仿佛怒火也一起被那两道魔法阵冻结，接着跑到了草丛里狂吐起来
而执行这一切的狄曼列则是依旧平静，再次举起了手杖，接着淡然挥下
咔嚓—————！
咔啦—————！
声音一次次响起，卡里伯爵也在狄曼列平静的目光中，被一寸寸的活生生敲碎，地上的血渣也越来越多
直到只剩三分之一个身体的卡里伯爵即将咽气，狄曼列那几乎不带感情的声音才响起，最后一次举起手杖的同时缓缓吐出了几个字：
“异端，审判”
话音落下，手杖如同死神的镰刀，毫不留情地收割了这个水晶城前任管理者的生命
在这过程中，无论是贵族青年身旁的皇家骑士，还是刚刚依旧陪着卡里伯爵的骑士和护卫，都没有任何人敢上前阻拦
无论是因为律法，还是狄曼列的实力
尽管从体系上来看，在众人认知里已经不是异端审判官的狄曼列就算额外具备审问权和裁决权，也没有资格审判一名城市的领主
魔法阵消失，狄曼列在做完这一切后没有太多反应，只是默默的在档案册上划了几笔，而后便看向了城主城堡里的骑士：“过几天就会有新的领主上任，你们正常工作就好，顺便和执政官说一声，有决定不了和解决不了的事直接来找我”
“好，好的，狄曼列典狱长”
“对了，和执政官说一声，关于受害者维罗娜的补偿，等她出狱办理帝国居住证明后就发给她”
“是！”
还处在刚刚一幕没回过神来的维罗娜听到自己的名字有些茫然的指了指自己：“诶？我吗？”
content_en:
Listening to Diamanlie's words, the aristocratic young man who had never been treated like this since he was a child finally couldn't hold back his anger anymore: "Do you know who I am?! My uncle is Duke Humo!!!"
After the words fell, both the prison guards and the prisoners showed surprised expressions.
One of the eight Dukes of the Mawson Empire. His name alone is enough to make a city tremble, let alone the nobleman in front of him who claims to be his nephew.
Even Verona, who is an elemental elf dragon, knows that something is wrong. This matter has become very complicated. She silently prays in her heart that her savior, the purple-haired young man, will not be involved, even if she gives up trying the murderer, Count Cary.
Of course, she was also prepared to break free from the restraining magic device and transform into a dragon to escape to attract attention.
However, in the face of the aristocratic young man's words, which were enough for most people to respond respectfully, Diamanlie remained calm and did not even respond.
Diamanlie looked at Count Cary and slowly recorded something in the file:
"For the above crimes, the sentence will be executed——————"
"Ice punishment, death penalty"
After the words fell, before anyone could react, two magic circles instantly enveloped Count Cary, and then suddenly lit up.
It wasn't until Count Cary, who gradually turned into an ice sculpture, screamed and begged for mercy that the prison guards, prisoners, and everyone present realized what had happened.
"Warden Dimanlie, I, I will explain everything and all the money!!! Please let me go and give me a good time!!!"
Obviously, Count Cary had just been placing his last hope on that noble young man. Now that the fear of death has come, he finally recognizes the reality.
But for Diamanlie, it makes no difference whether he begs for mercy or not.
Facing this cruel scene, Verona, who was only born for more than ten years, subconsciously covered her eyes, but forced herself to open them again
It's not that she is intolerant or sympathetic, it's just that she has rarely faced such cruel things. After all, she has only been in contact with some gentle elves before.
But as an elemental elf dragon, she quickly accepted all this information and turned it into nourishment for her mental growth.
But before she could gradually accept it, Diamanlie had already raised his cane and struck it at Count Cary, who was not yet dead.
Click——————
With the sound of breaking, Earl Cary's arm was directly knocked into ice slag, and finally scattered on the ground.
His blood and bones were completely frozen, so not a drop of blood escaped.
"Ahhhhhh..."
The ice has spread to Earl Cary's throat, causing him to only whimper in pain
Seeing this scene, Verona finally couldn't help but closed her eyes, and subconsciously grabbed Diamanlie's black windbreaker.
The noble young man on the side was too shocked to say a word, as if his anger was also frozen by the two magic circles, and then ran into the grass and vomited wildly.
Diamanlie, who carried out all this, remained calm, raised his cane again, and then calmly waved it down.
Click————!
Click——————!
The sound rang again and again, and Earl Cary was also crushed inch by inch under Dimanlie's calm eyes. There were more and more blood residues on the ground.
It wasn't until Count Cary, who had only one-third of his body left, was about to die, that almost emotionless voice of Diamanlie sounded. He raised his cane for the last time and slowly uttered a few words:
"Heresy, Judgment"
After the words fell, the cane was like the scythe of death, ruthlessly harvesting the life of the former manager of Crystal City.
During this process, no one dared to step forward to stop him, whether it was the royal knights beside the noble young man or the knights and guards who had just accompanied Count Cary.
Whether it’s because of the law or Dimanlie’s strength
Although from a system point of view, Diamanlie, who is no longer a heretic judge in everyone's perception, is not qualified even if he has additional interrogation and ruling powers.Trial a city lord
The magic circle disappeared. Dimanlie did not react much after doing all this. He just silently made a few strokes on the file book, and then looked at the knights in the city lord's castle: "There will be a new lord taking office in a few days. You can just work normally. By the way, tell the consul that if you have anything that cannot be decided or solved, come to me directly."
"Okay, okay, Warden Demanlie"
"By the way, let's talk to the consul about the compensation for the victim Verona. It will be given to her after she is released from prison and applies for an empire residence certificate."
"Yes!"
Verona, who was still recovering from the scene just now, pointed at herself in confusion when she heard her name: "Eh? Me?"
